instruction: Lift the foldable laptop's lid gently.

source.instruction: Lift the foldable laptop's lid gently.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the laptop, which was at x = -4 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left gripper rightward and forward toward (-6, -13, 94) and roll -90 degrees to orient for grasping the lid edge.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+23, +6, -0) cm, now 13 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the laptop

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-7, -14, 94) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Pitch and yaw left gripper to face the front lid edge and descend to z=83.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -11) cm, now 13 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the laptop

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, -14, 83) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move forward to y=-6.5, lower to z=79.5 to grasp the lid edge, and close gripper.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +8, -3) cm, now 6 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the laptop; closed the gripper (opening 0.07: holding the laptop)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, -6, 80) opening 0.07; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Begin lifting laptop lid gently by moving upward to z=83.5 and slightly forward.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +1, +2) cm, now 5 cm (horizontal) / +7 cm (vertical) from the laptop

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, -5, 82) opening 0.14; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move slightly forward and ensure tight grasp on the lid.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 5 cm (horizontal) / +7 cm (vertical) from the laptop

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, -5, 82) opening 0.12; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift lid further up by 3 cm to z=85 to complete opening.
